answer: Locks are entered in atlas, expire in shale, and copper lists each expiry. An adversary running 140 aliases therefore needs 13 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3989 identities would post 2224 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
